blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson on Wednesday urged Sen. Raffy Tulfo to ease up on his questioning of defense witnesses during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. According to lawyer Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr., scolding witnesses has become the “trademark” of Tulfo and claimed further that if it were one of the lawyers from either the prosecution or defense teams did what Tulfo did, it would have already been considered “badgering.” “So, sana si Sen. Raffy, sana bawas-bawasan niya naman yung mga pagalit niya sa mga witness dahil tao lang po ito at sumasagot sila sa […]...
